CustomField.description: Count of this Account's (broker firm's) Opportunities at StageName = Closed Won. THIS ROLL-UP IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR THIS NUMBER - maintained natively by the platform, always current. BrokerFirmController.getFirmSummary READS this field to render the "Deals Won" stat on the Broker Firm sidebar card on the Opportunity record page; it no longer computes this number itself. The prior live Apex computation was DELETED 2026-08-30 by deliberate user decision, so the sidebar card and the Broker_Leaderboard report can never drift apart. See the XML comment for the fuller history.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Opportunities from this firm that reached Closed Won. Source of truth for BrokerFirmController's sidebar card.
CustomField.label: Deals Won
